svg.title: USB 2.0 to Nessum adapter - schematic rev 0
svg.text: BRIDGE MCU ↔ NESSUM IC (RMII MAC-to-MAC + UART)
USB 2.0 bus-powered: ≤ 500 mA @ 5 V. Estimated load 0.9–1.4 W (spec §5).
Each IC: 100 nF per supply pin + 10 µF bulk, placed at the pins.
per NXP RT1060 HW design guide
Fit only if neither the RT1062 nor the SC1320A
sources the 50 MHz RMII reference clock.
pin names are placeholders until the SC1320A datasheet
100 Mbit/s · TX→RX crossed · no PHY · no MDIO
UART: Nessum IC configuration / key load
Medium: existing RS-485 twisted pair OR 24 V AC/DC cable (SELV only, no mains).
C3/C4 pass 2–28 MHz and block 24 V DC / 50–60 Hz AC.
D1 must not conduct on 24 V AC peaks (~34 V).
24 V medium: fit RF chokes at each load and at the supply (spec §6.2).
1. Rev 0 = architecture schematic: every part and net, no pin numbers.
2. SC1320A pin names and its support parts are placeholders pending the datasheet (NDA).
3. RMII is MAC-to-MAC: MCU TXD/TX_EN → IC RXD/CRS_DV and back. REF_CLK source TBD.
4. Passive values are starting points; confirm against part datasheets / reference designs.
5. Production: HAB secure boot + SWD fuse lock are mandatory (common network key).
6. Next: draw rev A in KiCad from this sheet once the SC1320A datasheet is available.
Host: TI AM62x (eth2) · Bridge: i.MX RT1062 · Nessum: SC1320A
